title: Clean template machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, a number $m\in\mathbb N$ of work tapes, and a source index $\mathrm{src}\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, define an $m$-work-tape Turing machine by composing a clearing pass on the source tape, a backward skip on that tape, and a second clearing pass on it.
